title: Defend CPU audit
description: Audit trail from the host CPU alert through triage, the agent decision, the diagnostics action, the Security case, and the true or false positive verdict. Each stage has its own state.

config.title: Trail
esql_query: FROM sibs-defend-audit | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS alerts = COUNT(*) WHERE event.action == "alert", triages = COUNT(*) WHERE event.action == "triage", agents = COUNT(*) WHERE event.action == "agent", diagnostics = COUNT(*) WHERE sibs.diagnostics == "requested", cases = COUNT(*) WHERE event.action == "case", verdicts = COUNT(*) WHERE event.action == "verdict", true_positives = COUNT(*) WHERE sibs.verdict == "true_positive"
config.template:
Defend CPU audit

From the alert to the verdict

Alert is triggered or not triggered. Triage is done or pending. The case is opened or pending. The verdict is true or false positive.
